mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, user_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS comment_id, c.post_id, c.user_id AS author_user_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, c.content, c.created_at FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.id ASC
